title: How Tibo Louis-Lucas bootstrapped Tweet Hunter to a $10M exit and now builds with equity partners
summary: Tibo explains why he left venture-backed teams for lean bootstrapping: ship a product a week, follow revenue only, and kill what doesn't work. He covers equity-sharing with creators, an earn-out sale structure, the new modes in the AI era, and his equity-partnership model of buying or partnering on small products.

principles.text: Judge ideas by revenue, not free users or compliments; kill products that miss your revenue threshold.
principles.quote: revenue was the only uh metric that we were following to decide if we would continue or shift to another ID
